data.description: Seen from the side, the Relaxed Bench has a black steel frame that bends back in one sweep, setting the backrest at a reclined angle. Wooden slats form the seat and back, and the curved frame ends act as low armrests at each side. People tend to sit longer on a reclined bench, so it suits a lake edge, a viewpoint in a park or a hotel garden better than a quick stop beside a gate. It sits in the CoreCraft garden decor collection under the Sand Beige colour listing. items.pText: Seen from the side, the Relaxed Bench has a black steel frame that bends back in one sweep, setting the backrest at a reclined angle. Wooden slats form the seat and back, and the curved frame ends act as low armrests at each side. People tend to sit longer on a reclined bench, so it suits a lake edge, a viewpoint in a park or a hotel garden better than a quick stop beside a gate. It sits in the CoreCraft garden decor collection under the Sand Beige colour listing. Measurements and warranty terms come with your quote, and we can mark Relaxed Bench positions on a layout drawing alongside your other equipment.

Its curved steel frame stands on four feet that we fix self-standing on paving or grout into soil. Because the backrest leans back, leave enough walking space behind it if the bench backs onto a path. At service visits, tighten the slat screws and look for chipped paint on the frame, touching it up before rust can start.
